body:
<!-- pr-reviewer: 506beda020bbe576294122dccc7b483bf8167019 -->

**Verdict: Ready for the maintainer to merge.**

Review tier: standard. This PR does not change posted G-code, gouge or collision checks, stock simulation, or geometry. It only adds AccessKit names to UI inputs.

### What is good

- Each changed input gets an accessible name. The names are clear and they are unique for each row (for example, "Axis X travel min", "Condition 1 role").
- The new helpers `num_named`, `num_feed_named` and `num_plain_named` (`crates/ui/src/egui_app/fields.rs:133-145`) call the same `num_sized` and `plain_drag` paths as `num`, `num_feed` and `num_plain`. The unit lens, the precision and the inch writeback do not change. Thus, the values that go into the machine draft do not change.
- `fields::named` only sets the AccessKit label. Nothing that the user sees changes.
- Five new pin tests use the shared `fixture_plate_tests::unnamed_inputs` walker.
- All changed files are below 400 lines. There is no new `unwrap`, `expect` or `panic!` in production code. There are no golden, snapshot PNG, dependency, `build.rs`, `scripts/`, `.github/` or process-file changes. The decision file `docs/decisions/1119-machine-input-names.md` is present. The `Changelog:` line is present.
- `Refs #1119` (not `Fixes`) is correct. Issue #1119 tells each page-family slice to use `Refs`.

### Local results (PR head trial-merged with upstream/main b0b443b)

| Step | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` | ok, 129 s, 0 failed |
| camcraft-ui lib | 782 passed, 0 failed, 5 ignored |
| ui:boundary / boundary_picks / sinker_setup / theme_files | 3 / 6 / 1 / 14 passed |
| ui:machine (extra) | 6 passed |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings` | clean |

### Mutations (done again by the reviewer)

I removed three names and ran the five pins:

1. `machines_pane.rs`: removed the "Filter machines by kind" name. Result: `the_machines_pane_names_every_input` is RED (`ComboBox = Some("All")`).
2. `machine_edm_editor.rs`: removed the "Condition {n} role" name. Result: `the_sinker_machine_editor_names_every_input` is RED (`ComboBox = Some("rough")`).
3. `machine_editor.rs`: changed "Axis {ax} travel max" back to `pages::num`. Result: the mill and wire editor pins are RED (unnamed `SpinButton`).

After I restored the files, all five pins are GREEN.

### Requested before merge

None.

### Notes (not blocking)

1. `crates/ui/src/egui_app/machine_editor.rs:249`: the direction combo name uses `a.name.trim()` directly. If the user clears the axis name, the name is "+ direction". The rapid, feed, travel and resolution names use the `#<n>` fallback (`ax`). You can use the same fallback here.
2. `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tests/machine_wire_edm.rs:172`: the mill editor pin is in the wire EDM test file. A machine-editor test file is a better location. This is a small placement point.
3. Screenshots: the body has no before/after screenshots. This PR changes no visible pixels (only AccessKit labels), so screenshots are not necessary. For the next slices, write "No visible change" in the body, so that the reader knows this.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
